The changes ensure that both the receive and transmit packet statistics are correctly updated by using the appropriate data index (`data[1]`) instead of the erroneous index (`data[4]`). This fix is consistent across both the physical function (PF) and virtual function (VF) implementations, indicating a unified approach to resolving the bug in the TQP statistics query.
